transcript.summary:
I have successfully created a complete, self-contained Tetris game in a single HTML file named tetris.html. The game includes all requested features:

- Visible 10x20 playing field with grid
- All seven standard Tetromino pieces (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z) with distinct colors
- Full rotation functionality using arrow keys
- Left/right movement with arrow keys
- Gravity and piece dropping
- Line clearing with proper scoring system (40, 100, 300, 1200 points for 1-4 lines)
- Score display that updates in real-time
- Next piece preview
- Start/Pause/Restart controls
- Game over detection with final score display
- Increasing difficulty as the game progresses

The implementation is fully self-contained with no external dependencies, using only HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The visual design features a modern dark theme with glowing accents and a clean layout for optimal gameplay experience.
